title: Wren and the Asset
author: Ada Halloran
blurb: Wren Villalobos, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
